job.title: Production Coordinator - Schoolwear
job.description:
Production Coordinator – Schoolwear
Melbourne | Full-time | Garment Production

We are seeking an experienced Production Coordinator to join an established and growing schoolwear business. This is a hands-on role coordinating garment production from pre-production samples through to bulk delivery, working closely with overseas suppliers and internal sales teams.

The role
  • Manage a high volume of production orders and  pre-production samples annually
  • Coordinate production across an approved supplier base in China and Vietnam
  • Review production documentation, approvals, pricing and supplier allocations
  • Monitor production milestones, identify risks and proactively manage delivery timelines
  • Coordinate seasonal, high-volume production cycles
  • Build strong relationships with overseas suppliers and internal sales teams
  • Assist with quality issues, replenishment orders and freight coordination
  • Contribute to improving production processes, systems and workflow consistency
About you
  • Previous experience in garment production
  • Direct experience in schoolwear or uniform manufacturing
  • Strong understanding of the end-to-end garment production lifecycle
  • Experience managing pre-production samples and bulk production orders
  • Highly organised with excellent attention to detail
  • Confident managing multiple orders and competing deadlines
  • Clear, calm and proactive communication style
  • Fluent Chinese or Vietnamese would be highly regarded
Success in this role will look like:
Accurate and efficient order management, early identification of production risks, strong supplier relationships and consistent execution through busy seasonal periods.

If you have schoolwear or uniform production experience and are looking for your next opportunity, we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: Retail Account Manager Teamwear
job.description:
Join an Established Sporting Brand in Western Australia

The Role
This is a hands-on account management role focused on building strong relationships with retailers, clubs, schools and commercial partners, identifying new business opportunities and delivering a high level of customer service throughout the sales and order lifecycle. As the key point of contact for WA retail accounts, you will be responsible for maintaining existing partnerships while driving sales growth and identifying opportunities to expand the business.


 Key responsibilities include:
  • Manage and develop WA retail customer accounts
  • Build strong relationships with retailers, clubs, schools and commercial partners
  • Identify new sales and business development opportunities
  • Manage licensed product sales to customers, retailers and AFL clubs
  • Handle customer enquiries, quotations and orders
  • Manage stock, custom football and indent orders
  • Communicate stock availability, backorders and expected lead times
  • Work closely with the warehouse to prioritise orders and distribution
  • Conduct regular backorder reporting and customer follow-up
  • Coordinate sales returns, warranty claims, replacements and repairs through Sage System
  • Liaise with Accounts regarding payments, credits, account holds and stock release
  • Assist with Eastern States customer enquiries when required

About You You will be an experienced Retail Account Manager who enjoys building relationships, growing accounts and providing excellent customer service.

Ideally, you will bring:
  • 5+ years' experience in account management, sales or business development
  • Experience managing retail or consumer-facing accounts
  • A proven track record of revenue growth and customer retention
  • Strong commercial negotiation and account planning skills
  • Sound analytical, reporting and forecasting capabilities
  • Strong commercial and business acumen
  • A customer-focused and relationship-driven approach
  • A strategic, growth-focused mindset
  • Strong accountability and a results-driven attitude
  • Excellent communication, collaboration and influencing skills
If you are a proactive Account Manager who enjoys developing long-term customer relationships while driving commercial growth, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Sales & MTM Consultant | Luxury Menswear
job.description:
The Opportunity
You'll become a trusted advisor to a diverse range of clients, including professionals, grooms, wedding parties, and event attendees. From the first conversation through to final delivery, you'll play a key role in ensuring every client receives outstanding service and expert guidance.

Rather than a traditional retail sales environment, this position focuses on understanding individual needs, providing personalised recommendations, and delivering a seamless customer journey.
  • Deliver personalised styling and consultation experiences
  • Build lasting client relationships that drive repeat and referral business
  • Guide clients through product, fit and styling selections
  • Convert enquiries into appointments and sales opportunities
  • Manage wedding parties and key event timelines
  • Maintain exceptional communication throughout the client journey
  • Support showroom presentation and CRM management
  • Collaborate with the team to deliver outstanding results
About You
  • 3+ years' experience in sales, client service or account management
  • A natural relationship builder with exceptional communication skills
  • Confident engaging with clients face-to-face and over the phone
  • Passionate about style, fashion and helping people look and feel their best
  • Highly organised with strong follow-up and attention to detail
  • Professional, polished and target-driven
  • Experience in luxury retail, hospitality, weddings or premium service environments is highly regarded
  • Available to work weekends as part of a rotating roster
What's In It For You?
  • Attractive salary + uncapped commissions and bonuses
  • Wardrobe and phone allowance
  • Monthly RDO
  • Career growth within a rapidly growing business
  • Work with a premium clientele in a luxury environment
  • Supportive, high-performing team culture
  • Be part of an ambitious brand with exciting growth plans
Enjoy a consistent roster with two consecutive days off each week:

Monday & Tuesday – Off
Wednesday & Thursday – 9:00am–5:00pm
Friday & Saturday – 1:00pm–9:00pm
Sunday – 9:00am–5:00pm

If you're passionate about delivering outstanding customer experiences and enjoy helping people feel their best, we'd love to hear from you.
